targets.query:
import "date"
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Europe/Zurich")
hour = date.hour(t: v.timeRangeStop)
daytime = hour >= 8 and hour < 17
solar = from(bucket: "waid-bucket")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 120m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "solar" and r["_field"] == "power" and r.channel == "0")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(value: 0.0)
  |> last()
  |> toFloat()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: v.timeRangeStop, _value: r._value, _field: "solar"}))

  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 120m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "status" and r["_field"] == "reachable")
  |> last()
  |> toFloat()

targets.query:
import "math"
every = if uint(v: v.windowPeriod) < uint(v: 30s) then 30s else v.windowPeriod
grid = from(bucket: "waid-bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "mqtt_consumer" and r["_field"] == "total_act_power")
  |> drop(columns: ["host", "topic"])
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: every, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "grid"}))
solar = from(bucket: "waid-bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "solar" and r["_field"] == "power" and r.channel == "0")
  |> drop(columns: ["host", "channel", "serial", "topic"])
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: every, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "solar"}))
union(tables: [grid, solar])
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      g = if exists r.grid then r.grid else math.NaN()
      s = if exists r.solar then r.solar else 0.0
      return {_time: r._time, Grid: g, Solar: if s > 0.0 then s else math.NaN(), "House load": if exists r.grid then r.grid + s else math.NaN()}
    })

panels.description: Kilowatt-hours the pack would have delivered to the apartment instead of the grid.

targets.query:
import "date"
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Europe/Zurich")
usable = float(v: ${battery_kwh})
eta = float(v: ${battery_eta})
start = date.truncate(t: date.add(d: -365d, to: v.timeRangeStop), unit: 1d)
stop = date.truncate(t: v.timeRangeStop, unit: 1d)
hours = from(bucket: "waid-bucket-downsampled")
  |> range(start: start, stop: stop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "energy_hourly" and (r["_field"] == "import_kwh" or r["_field"] == "export_kwh"))
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      import_kwh: if exists r.import_kwh then r.import_kwh else 0.0,
      export_kwh: if exists r.export_kwh then r.export_kwh else 0.0
    }))
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
walked = hours
  |> reduce(
      fn: (r, accumulator) => {
        dead = usable <= 0.0 or eta <= 0.0
        export = if r.export_kwh > 0.0 then r.export_kwh else 0.0
        imported = if r.import_kwh > 0.0 then r.import_kwh else 0.0
        hoch = date.weekDay(t: r._time) != 0 and date.hour(t: r._time) >= 6 and date.hour(t: r._time) < 22
        room = usable - accumulator.soc
        take = if dead then 0.0 else if export < room / eta then export else room / eta
        soc1 = if dead then accumulator.soc else accumulator.soc + take * eta
        give = if dead then 0.0 else if imported < soc1 then imported else soc1
        soc2 = if dead then accumulator.soc else soc1 - give
        return {
          soc: soc2,
          charged_ht: accumulator.charged_ht + (if hoch then take else 0.0),
          charged_nt: accumulator.charged_nt + (if hoch then 0.0 else take),
          shifted_ht: accumulator.shifted_ht + (if hoch then give else 0.0),
          shifted_nt: accumulator.shifted_nt + (if hoch then 0.0 else give),
          leftover_export: accumulator.leftover_export + export - take,
          leftover_import: accumulator.leftover_import + imported - give
        }
      },
      identity: {soc: 0.0, charged_ht: 0.0, charged_nt: 0.0, shifted_ht: 0.0, shifted_nt: 0.0, leftover_export: 0.0, leftover_import: 0.0}
    )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: stop, _value: r.shifted_ht + r.shifted_nt, _field: "Shifted"}))

          shifted_nt: accumulator.shifted_nt + (if hoch then 0.0 else give),
          leftover_export: accumulator.leftover_export + export - take,
          leftover_import: accumulator.leftover_import + imported - give
        }
      },
      identity: {soc: 0.0, charged_ht: 0.0, charged_nt: 0.0, shifted_ht: 0.0, shifted_nt: 0.0, leftover_export: 0.0, leftover_import: 0.0}
    )
buyHT = float(v: ${buy_ht})
buyNT = float(v: ${buy_nt})
feedHT = float(v: ${feed_ht})
feedNT = float(v: ${feed_nt})
pack = float(v: ${battery_chf})
saved = walked
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: stop,
      _value: r.shifted_ht * buyHT + r.shifted_nt * buyNT - r.charged_ht * feedHT - r.charged_nt * feedNT,
      _field: "Payback"
    }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r._value > 0.0 then pack / r._value else 0.0}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0.0)
saved
